import sys,json,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,'products/services/sqlite-repair/fulfillment')
import diagnose as D
out=pathlib.Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/cases/fk-mismatch-rowid');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
cats="CREATE TABLE cats (name TEXT NOT NULL, birthdate TEXT, fur TEXT, weight_kg REAL) STRICT;\nINSERT INTO cats VALUES ('Zophie','2021-01-24','gray tabby',5.6),('Miyuki','2016-12-24','siamese',6.2);\n"
vac="CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vaccinations (vaccine TEXT, date_administered TEXT, administered_by TEXT, cat_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats(rowid)) STRICT;\n"
q_as="INSERT INTO vaccinations VALUES ('rabies','2023-06-06','Dr. Echo',1);\nSELECT cats.rowid, cats.name, vaccinations.vaccine FROM cats INNER JOIN vaccinations ON cats.rowid = vaccinations.cat_id;"
cases={
 'as-written-fk-off':dict(case_id='so79846840-as-written-fk-off',seed_sql='PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF;\n'+cats+vac,query_sql=q_as,expected_last_rows=[['1','Zophie','rabies']]),
 'as-written-fk-on':dict(case_id='so79846840-as-written-fk-on',seed_sql='PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n'+cats+vac,query_sql=q_as,expected_last_rows=[['1','Zophie','rabies']]),
 'fixed':dict(case_id='so79846840-fixed-rebuild',seed_sql='PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF;\n'+cats+vac+
  "CREATE TABLE cats_new (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, birthdate TEXT, fur TEXT, weight_kg REAL) STRICT;\nINSERT INTO cats_new (id,name,birthdate,fur,weight_kg) SELECT rowid,name,birthdate,fur,weight_kg FROM cats;\nDROP TABLE cats;\nALTER TABLE cats_new RENAME TO cats;\n"+
  "CREATE TABLE vaccinations_new (vaccine TEXT, date_administered TEXT, administered_by TEXT, cat_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats(id)) STRICT;\nINSERT INTO vaccinations_new SELECT * FROM vaccinations;\nDROP TABLE vaccinations;\nALTER TABLE vaccinations_new RENAME TO vaccinations;\nPRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n",
  query_sql="INSERT INTO vaccinations VALUES ('rabies','2023-06-06','Dr. Echo',1);\nSELECT cats.id, cats.rowid, cats.name, vaccinations.vaccine FROM cats INNER JOIN vaccinations ON cats.id = vaccinations.cat_id;\nINSERT INTO vaccinations VALUES ('rabies','2023-06-06','Dr. Echo',99);",
  expected_last_rows=None)}
summ={}
for k,c in cases.items():
  c={a:b for a,b in c.items() if b is not None}
  (out/('case-'+k+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(c,indent=1),encoding='utf-8')
  r=D.diagnose(c);(out/('report-'+k+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')
  a=r['runs']['all_statements']
  summ[k]=dict(version=r['sqlite_version'],seed_error=a.get('seed_error'),error=a.get('error'),stmts=[(s['index'],s.get('step_rc'),s.get('row_count'),s.get('rows')) for s in a.get('statements',[])],expected_match=r.get('expected_match'),open=a['open_statements_after_run'],close=a['close_rc'],denied=a['denied'])
print(json.dumps(summ,indent=1))
